title: Integrative pharmacological analysis of modified Zuojin formula: Inhibiting the HIF-1alpha-mediated glycolytic pathway in chronic atrophic gastritis.
authors: Liu, Shan; Zhang, Tai; Fang, Lihui; Hu, Lanshuo; Yin, Xiaolan; Tang, Xudong
one_liner_zh: 该研究探讨中药复方对慢性萎缩性胃炎的作用机制，涉及HIF-1alpha通路和分子对接，但核心是疾病药理而非蛋白质-DNA互作，无AI或物理模拟方法，与本课题无关。
abstract: ETHNOPHARMACOLOGICAL RELEVANCE: Zuojin formula (ZJF) is a well-known herbal medicine in Pharmacopoeia of China, which is widely used for gastritis. Modified Zuojin formula (MZJF) was adapted based on traditional Chinese medicine (TCM) theories concerning gastric atrophy and dysplasia, along with extensive clinical experience, has been clinically employed to treat chronic atrophic gastritis (CAG). However, the underlying mechanisms by which MZJF intervenes in CAG remain to be fully elucidated. AIM OF THE STUDY: The aim of this study was to evaluate the effects of MZJF intervention in CAG and explore its potential mechanisms. METHODS: Four induction factors were used to establish a CAG rat model. HE and AB-PAS staining was utilized to assess the effects of MZJF in the intervention of CAG. The stomach weight index and gastric acid pH was used to assess the overall state of stomach. ELISA was used to assess the gastric mucosal inflammatory response. Using transmission electron microscopy to observe chief cells and parietal cells, we evaluated the improvement of ultrastructure by MZJF. Through network pharmacology analysis, the possible regulatory mechanism of MZJF in CAG was preliminarily explored. Binding interactions between MZJF components and predicted targets were explored using molecular docking. Subsequently, quantitative real-time PCR (qRT-PCR), Western blot, biochemical analysis and TUNEL staining were applied to validate the effect of MZJF on predicted pathway. RESULTS: MZJF treatment ameliorated gastric mucosal pathology, inflammation, cellular ultrastructural damage and PG levels, halted the exacerbation of CAG in rats, along with a reduction in stomach weight index and gastric acid pH. A total of 79 compounds in MZJF targeting 203 CAG-related molecules were identified through network pharmacology. Enrichment analysis of the core targets was focused on the hypoxia inducible factor-1alpha (HIF-1alpha) signaling pathway. Molecular docking results identified HIF-1alpha as stable binding targets for MZJF primary components. Subsequently, PCR, WB, and biochemical results showed that MZJF suppressed the gene and protein expression levels of HIF-1alpha and its downstream molecules including glycolytic enzymes and transporters, modulated glucose, pyruvic acid and lactate levels in gastric mucosal tissue. Moreover, MZJF induced apoptosis of gastric epithelial cells, as evidenced by the upregulation of cleaved caspase-3, Bax, Bax/Bcl-2 and TUNEL positive cells ratio. CONCLUSIONS: MZJF suppressed the HIF-1alpha-mediated glycolytic pathway, and promoted cell apoptosis, thereby halting the malignant transformation of CAG. The study provides a valuable reference point for applying TCM in preventing and treating CAG.
abstract_zh: 民族药理学相关性：左金方（ZJF）是中国药典中著名的草药方剂，广泛用于治疗胃炎。基于中医（TCM）关于胃萎缩和异型增生的理论，并结合丰富的临床经验，改良左金方（MZJF）被研制出来，并已在临床上用于治疗慢性萎缩性胃炎（CAG）。然而，MZJF干预CAG的潜在机制尚未完全阐明。研究目的：本研究旨在评估MZJF干预CAG的效果，并探讨其潜在机制。方法：采用四种诱导因素建立CAG大鼠模型。利用HE和AB-PAS染色评估MZJF干预CAG的效果。使用胃重量指数和胃酸pH值评估胃的整体状态。采用ELISA评估胃黏膜炎症反应。通过透射电子显微镜观察主细胞和壁细胞，评估MZJF对超微结构的改善作用。通过网络药理学分析，初步探讨MZJF在CAG中可能的调控机制。利用分子对接技术探索MZJF成分与预测靶点之间的结合相互作用。随后，应用定量实时PCR（qRT-PCR）、Western blot、生化分析和TUNEL染色验证MZJF对预测通路的影响。结果：MZJF治疗改善了胃黏膜病理、炎症、细胞超微结构损伤和PG水平，阻止了大鼠CAG的恶化，同时降低了胃重量指数和胃酸pH值。通过网络药理学，共鉴定出MZJF中79种化合物靶向203个CAG相关分子。核心靶点的富集分析聚焦于缺氧诱导因子-1α（HIF-1α）信号通路。分子对接结果确定HIF-1α为MZJF主要成分的稳定结合靶点。随后，PCR、WB和生化结果显示，MZJF抑制了HIF-1α及其下游分子（包括糖酵解酶和转运体）的基因和蛋白表达水平，调节了胃黏膜组织中的葡萄糖、丙酮酸和乳酸水平。此外，MZJF诱导胃上皮细胞凋亡，表现为cleaved caspase-3、Bax、Bax/Bcl-2上调及TUNEL阳性细胞比例增加。结论：MZJF抑制了HIF-1α介导的糖酵解通路，并促进细胞凋亡，从而阻止CAG的恶性转化。该研究为应用中医药防治CAG提供了有价值的参考点。
